command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_thermal3d.py tests/test_thermal3d_budget.py tests/test_thermal_common.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Unit slab with fixed end temperatures 1.2 and 0.4, superposed decaying sine of amplitude 0.35, D3Q7 tau=0.8, volumetric capacity 2.3. Accumulate cross-section-averaged kinetic heat through all x links to t=1/8. Each time step check layer and full interior budgets. At final time independently compare cumulative link heat to the analytical time integral of Fourier flux, and storage to the spatial integral of the temperature change between the two links adjacent to the reservoirs.
